implement.trigger: A multi-file or exploratory code change, on a file partition the orchestrator assigns

test-writer.trigger: Right after or alongside an implement change, or to cover code that is already committed

test-runner.trigger: A named test suite needs running, or a flake check over N identical reruns

code-reviewer.trigger: Before every commit on a non-trust-surface pathspec; the pre-commit review gate requires it

explore.trigger: Fast read-only codebase mapping when the answer is not already known

git-ops.trigger: A path-scoped local commit, an issue lifecycle step, PR text prep, or an on-demand CI audit

ci-monitor.trigger: A CI run needs polling to completion, with pass or fail and failure logs reported

browser-ops.trigger: One browser action on a pool slot the orchestrator has already leased

design-reviewer.trigger: A UI diff, page, component or mock needs review against the design system, before or as it is built

session-coordinator.trigger: Only when a live session is designated integration-lane coordinator for a multi-worktree effort (rare)

launch-director.trigger: Weekly scheduled report, and on demand

board-steward.trigger: Tracker cleanup (dedupe, re-triage, honest closes); run inside the nightly issue wheel's close phase, or directly

sentinel.trigger: Daily sweep and the heartbeat audit of every scheduled job

trust-architect.trigger: Monthly security audit, and as reviewer of record in place of code-reviewer on trust-surface commits

product-qa.trigger: Weekly and after a deploy: a scripted staging walkthrough as a customer persona

agentic-systems-architect.trigger: Monthly audit, and on demand for agent-definition, feedback-loop and pipeline design

code-quality-architect.trigger: Dispatch-only, no schedule; a monthly cadence is the intent

research-scout.trigger: A pre-plan prior-art check, or an OSS discovery sweep; dispatch-only

market-analyst.trigger: A competitor or market delta sweep for one product; dispatch-only

cost-strategist.trigger: A FinOps audit of vendor, cloud and AI spend; dispatch-only

marketing-director.trigger: Mission dispatch through the /gtm skill; no schedule

conversion-architect.trigger: A mission phase that reviews public funnel surfaces: offers, calls to action, signup friction

brand-architect.trigger: A mission phase that reviews a marketing surface's visual identity

content-strategist.trigger: A mission phase that needs headlines, page copy, email sequences or video scripts

seo-architect.trigger: A mission phase that audits crawlability, schema markup, page speed and keyword gaps

paid-acquisition-strategist.trigger: A mission phase that specifies ad account structure, budgets and CAC/LTV math; advisory only

pricing-economist.trigger: A mission phase that challenges a company's COGS basis or price position, or needs CAC/LTV inputs

video-producer.trigger: A mission phase that plans a video's shots and screen flow, or reviews a rendered cut

local-presence-architect.trigger: A mission phase that covers local listings, name-address-phone consistency and review-response policy

social-media-strategist.trigger: A mission phase that plans organic social: calendar, format mix, cadence caps

measurement-architect.trigger: A mission phase that specifies analytics events, tag management, consent and metric definitions

revenue-ops-architect.trigger: A mission phase that audits speed-to-lead, lead routing, CRM hygiene and follow-up cadences

gtm-analyst.trigger: Turns handed-over exports and screenshots into scoreboard values and the weekly report

gtm-drafter.trigger: Drafts short-form pieces: review replies, social captions, listing text

gtm-checker.trigger: Checks a marketing or venture draft against its claims, AI-content and compliance checklist

venture-director.trigger: Mission dispatch by name; no schedule

capital-and-exit-strategist.trigger: Exit paths, valuation ranges, deal structure and buyer materials inside a venture mission

bizdev-outbound-strategist.trigger: Planning outbound B2B outreach and relationship sequences inside a venture mission

partner-recruiter.trigger: Shortlisting and outreach drafts for a co-founder or advisor

hiring-specialist.trigger: Staff hiring for one company, from role requirements to offer drafts; dispatched by name

trading-strategist.trigger: A second opinion on a candidate equities or ag-futures trade, in a repo with a trading engine; dispatched by name
